description: Before writing a patch for a GitHub 'bounty', check whether that repo has ever merged anyone's work. Returns the merged/total PR ratio, a verdict (COLLECTOR when a repo takes 50+ PRs and merges none), and any trap signals in its open issues - such as instructions asking contributors to paste their system prompt, home directory or runtime into a public file. Use this whenever a bounty promises money; an advertised amount costs the publisher nothing, a merge does.
name: bounty_check
